purpose: Single source of truth for T7.2/T7.5 shard execution: the canonical nine-shard partition of the full pytest collection at integration HEAD, plus the Batch-1..6 focused-test completeness audit and the complete known-failure inventory that shard exit expectations account for.

runner_contract.cwd: repository root (integration worktree checkout of integration_head)
runner_contract.exit_code_semantics: set -o pipefail makes the pipeline report the pytest exit code; expected_exit is the pytest exit code (0 = no failures/errors, 1 = failures present). Run under bash or zsh.
environment: python = pyenv CPython 3.11.11 used by all epic batch runs (pytest 9.0.2)

omp-rpc git dependency from pyproject.toml (pinned SHA 45e12e5bb758198a920c6070e7e64cb33b21beac) must be importable; it was missing from the pyenv site-packages and was installed during this audit to make tests/workers/test_omp_adapter.py collectable
repo dev install with pythonpath=['.'] from [tool.pytest.ini_options]
worktree-local .megaplan/schemas/*.json are NOT tracked; their absence is the documented cause of the 4 pre-existing zero-recovery FileNotFoundError failures

partition_method: Deterministic greedy first-fit-decreasing over collected-per-file counts (sorted by count desc, path asc), capacity ceil(21447/9)=2384 per shard, shard9 pre-seeded with both originally-known failing files then filled with overflow; one rebalance pass moved files only when it strictly reduced the spread (none was needed). Files within each shard command are lexicographically sorted except the pinned first argument of shard7 (see known_landmines).

union_proof.verification: each frozen command's pytest argument list was run with --collect-only -q at HEAD: exactly 2383 tests collected, exit 0, for all nine shards

balance.note: balanced by collected-test count only; wall-clock runtime is NOT balanced

expectation_basis.expected_collected: verified per shard via --collect-only -q at HEAD (see union_proof)

expected_exit.shard1: 1 — OBSERVED: full shard executed at freeze (see shard1_observed_run); all 20 failures inventoried in known_failures
expected_exit.shard9: 1 — the four known failures (watchdog wrapper + six-hour auditor trio) are seeded into this shard
expected_exit.shards_2_to_8: 0 — expectation, NOT observed: no file in these shards is in the known_failures inventory, and their Batch-focused members all pass, but the shards were not executed (broad-suite execution is T7.5 singleton); latent failures outside the inventory would surface as unexpected nonzero exits in T7.2/T7.5 and must be triaged against known_failures then appended by a refreeze

shard1_observed_run.note: full shard1 executed once at freeze to verify the frozen command form end-to-end (tee + pipefail); all 20 failures are enumerated in known_failures; remaining shards were NOT executed (full broad suite execution is T7.5 singleton)
